core_obligations: Show that for f : X to S finite type with S Noetherian, r at least 0, and alpha a relative r-cycle on X/S, there is a proper completely decomposed morphism g : S' to S with g^*alpha in the image of equation-cycle-classes (tag 0H58) (proof lines 1186-1231). First, by Noetherian induction assume the result for pullbacks of alpha by closed immersions g : S' to S that are not isomorphisms (proof lines 1186-1188). Second, let S_1 be an irreducible component and S_2 the closure of the complement, viewed as reduced closed subschemes; if S_2 is nonempty the induction hypothesis holds for the pullbacks along S_1 to S and S_2 to S, the disjoint union S'_1 amal S'_2 to S of the two completely decomposed proper covers is completely decomposed and proper, and any closed subscheme of S'_1 times_S X flat of relative dimension at most r over S'_1 may be viewed as a closed subscheme of S' times_S X flat of relative dimension at most r over S' (author's footnote, content supplied), so the result holds for S; thus reduce to S' to S bijective (proof lines 1190-1204). Third, assume S integral with generic point eta and function field considerations: write alpha_eta = sum n_i [Y_i] as a finite sum, take the closures Z_i in X whose base change to eta is Y_i, apply morphisms-proposition-generic-flatness (tag 052A) to get a nonempty open U of S over which each Z_i is flat, then apply flat-lemma-flat-after-blowing-up (tag 081R) to find a U-admissible blowing up g : S' to S such that the strict transforms Z'_i of Z_i in X_{S'} are flat over S'; the family beta = sum n_i [Z'_i/X_{S'}/S']_r lies in the image of the cycle-classes map and equals g^*alpha by lemma-uniqueness-extension (tag 0H55) (proof lines 1206-1221). Fourth, the blowing up g need not be completely decomposed; denoting T the complement of U viewed as a closed subscheme, Noetherian induction provides a completely decomposed proper morphism T' to T with (T' to S)^*alpha in the image, and the disjoint union S' amal T' to S does the job (proof lines 1223-1230).
proof_roadmap: Set up Noetherian induction on the base (proof lines 1186-1188).
Glue the induction hypothesis over irreducible components and their complement closures, reducing to a bijective cover (proof lines 1190-1204).

Integral case: closures of the generic fibre components, generic flatness, and an admissible blowing up making the strict transforms flat, recognized as the pullback by uniqueness (proof lines 1206-1221).
Repair complete decomposability by Noetherian induction on the complement of the open and take the disjoint union (proof lines 1223-1230).
